Summary: Astrion Core Buildout & Cost Model (GATING)
Description:
Owner: Shane + Sully

The CEO's direct 10-day assignment to Shane and Sully: lock down WHAT Astrion Core must be built as across the discussed layers and WHAT it will cost. Core = one common platform (service layer + integration layer + data fabric) providing data/decision orchestration, secure mission-autonomy orchestration, and secure targeted-effects orchestration, with mission applications ('engines'/suites) running on top per AMSGRA/AGRA. Deliverable for the July 7-8 reconvene must include >=2 COAs, a baseline-architecture decision, a dev-seat/licensing cost model with stair-step tiers, and staffing for both Core infra and the separate mission-app dev teams. This is the gating deliverable - the reconvene is won or lost here.
